hooks.command: f=$(php -r "\$i=json_decode(stream_get_contents(STDIN),true); echo \$i[\"tool_input\"][\"file_path\"] ?? \"\";"); case "$f" in *.php) [ -f vendor/bin/pint ] && php vendor/bin/pint "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true

out=$(composer test:fast 2>&1); line=$(printf "%s" "$out" | sed -e "s/\[[0-9;]*m//g" | grep -o "Tests:.*" | head -1 | tr -s " "); [ -z "$line" ] && line="test:fast FAILED - run composer test:fast"; php -r "echo json_encode([\"systemMessage\"=>trim(\$argv[1])]);" "$line"
